readerCopy.body: Stress can pull you straight back into the comfort strategy you know by heart. When the Moon conjuncts the South Node, an old mood, family pattern, coping habit, or need for reassurance can feel unusually automatic. You may cancel the plan, call the same person, retreat into the same routine, or reach for the thing that has soothed you before. Comfort is not the problem. The question is what the habit costs when it becomes your only answer. Give yourself what actually helps now, not only what used to calm you down.
